# Patrick MacCartee — Realtor 510
# Licensed California Real Estate Agent | The Grubb Company | DRE #02142693

Patrick MacCartee is a licensed East Bay real estate agent with The Grubb Company,
specializing in buyer and seller representation in Oakland, Berkeley, Piedmont,
Alameda, and the greater East Bay. He operates under the brand Realtor 510 and
leads Team Crocker, a three-agent group focused on Crocker Highlands, Trestle Glen,
and surrounding neighborhoods. Patrick holds an MBA from the Haas School of Business
with a focus on pricing and auction theory. He is a major sponsor of Crocker
Highlands Elementary School and an active PTA member.

## Services

- Listing agent / seller representation
- Buyer representation
- Off-market access and East Bay market intelligence
- Home staging guidance and pre-sale preparation
- Relocation and home transition
